note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a LIE 4(b)-4(e); A06b LIE 4(b)-4(e); L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Liechtenstein, 2024
sources.said: Person has had 10 years of uninterrupted lawful and main residence in Liechtenstein. ... Renunciation of another citizenship required. ... n.a.
